headline: Modison, Oberoi Realty and LTM announce cash dividends
summary: Modison, Oberoi Realty and LTM declared dividends with a record date of October 23. Modison will pay ₹4 per share, Oberoi Realty ₹2 per share and LTM ₹25 per share. Modison reported sharply higher Q2FY27 profit and revenue, while Oberoi Realty’s profit rose modestly but its income fell. The payouts provide immediate cash returns to shareholders.

headline: Modison sets record date for upcoming dividend
hook: Third payout this year for Modison holders
summary: Modison Limited has announced October 23, 2026, as the record date for an upcoming dividend. Shareholders listed on the company's register by this date will be eligible for the payout. For Indian retail investors holding the stock, this date determines dividend entitlement.
why_it_matters: Determines shareholder eligibility for the upcoming dividend payout.

headline: Modison Limited reports September quarter financial results
summary: Modison Limited has submitted its financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange. The filing provides the company's performance metrics for the second quarter of the financial year. Retail investors can review these numbers to assess the company's operational and financial health.
why_it_matters: Quarterly earnings data updates your investment thesis.

headline: Modison Limited announces the resignation of its Company Secretary and Compliance Officer
summary: Modison Limited has informed the stock exchanges that Ms. Pooja Birendra Sinha will step down from her role as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer. Her resignation is scheduled to take effect from October 01, 2026. Retail investors should note that changes in key managerial personnel are routine administrative events for listed corporations.
whats_next: Appointment of a new compliance officer
why_it_matters: Routine compliance update with no financial impact on investors

headline: Modison submits SEBI compliance certificate for dematerialisation
summary: Modison has filed its compliance certificate with SEBI regarding its dematerialisation processes. This is a routine regulatory requirement for listed companies to ensure share records are maintained electronically. The filing confirms the company's adherence to standard depository participant protocols. It does not indicate any change in the company's financial or operational status.
why_it_matters: No direct impact on retail investor portfolios.

headline: Modison Limited submits compliance certificate under SEBI regulations
hook: Routine compliance filing submitted to the exchange
summary: Modison Limited has submitted its mandatory compliance certificate pursuant to the SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018. This is a routine regulatory filing required for listed companies to confirm the dematerialization and rematerialization of securities. The submission has no immediate impact on the company's financial performance or stock valuation. Indian retail investors holding shares do not need to take any action based on this procedural update.
why_it_matters: Routine regulatory filing with zero direct impact on stock price.
